name: Volunteer Program (high school students can apply)
what_you_do: Volunteers talk with the public. They help with current exhibits. They help families with activities on Community Sundays. They help at HoMA Nights. They also prepare mailings for members.
who_can_apply: The application has a box for high school students and a parent or guardian consent part. The program page does not state a minimum age.
duration: Not stated on the program page
deadline_text: No deadline. Openings depend on what each museum department needs.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online volunteer application. High school students check the high school box. A parent or guardian signs the consent part. Expect a short interview and a background check.
notes: The museum matches volunteers to openings, so you may wait to hear back. Teen roles are not described on the main program page. The older application form is what shows the high school box, the parent consent part, the background check and the interview.
